definition: ἀντι-λαμβάνω  [frequently in LXX for חָזַק hi., סָמַךְ, etc ;] to take instead of or in turn. Mid., with genitive, to take hold of;  __(a) of persons, to help (see MM, VGT, see word): Luk.1:54, Act.20:35;  __(b) of things, to partake of: 1Ti.6:2 (see Field, Notes, 210; Cremer, 386; and cf. συν-αντιλαμβάνω).† (AS)
